rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a government or other public official.

example.english: The government officer will meet the media today.
example.traditional: 政府官員今日會見傳媒。
example.jyutping: zing3 fu2 gun1 jyun4 gam1 jat6 wui6 gin3 cyun4 mui4

rows.note: Use this when officer means a police officer rather than an official in general.

example.english: That police officer helped me find my phone.
example.traditional: 嗰位警員幫我搵返部電話。
example.jyutping: go2 wai2 ging2 jyun4 bong1 ngo5 wan2 faan1 bou6 din6 waa2

rows.note: Use this for a senior or commanding authority figure, especially in a military or official hierarchy.

example.english: The senior officer has approved this operation.
example.traditional: 長官已經批准今次行動。
example.jyutping: zoeng2 gun1 ji5 ging1 pai1 zeon2 gam1 ci3 hang4 dung6

rows.note: Use this colloquial respectful address when speaking directly to a police officer.

example.jyutping: aa3 si1 ni1 dou6 m4 ho2 ji5 paak3 ce1
